headline: Anthropic IPO Valuation Projections Lowered to $1.2 Trillion Amid Market Volatility
summary: Target IPO valuation estimates for AI startup Anthropic were revised down to $1.2 trillion–$1.3 trillion from earlier peak figures near $2 trillion following recent technology equity liquidations on Wall Street.
why: Anthropic is a primary frontier AI developer; its valuation benchmarks serve as pricing indicators for the broader tech sector.

impacts.name: Anthropic
impacts.why: Broader public market tech corrections forced institutional investors to scale back private IPO valuation estimates.
